state: Finite slices of i32-coordinate points under ordinary allocation-success Rust execution.
cost: O(n log²n) time, O(n) peak auxiliary memory, O(log n) stack; unmeasured wall-clock cost.
forward: Return None for n<2; sort indexed points, select canonical zero pair if duplicates exist, else recursively combine half minima and inclusive y-sorted strip candidates using (distance,indices) order.
inverse: behavior_complement: Exclude None with n>=2, Some with n<2, indices outside 0<=i<j<n, incorrect squared separation, existence of a closer pair or a lexicographically smaller tied pair, and input mutation.

reverse_reconstruction: For result (i,j,d), compatible inputs have length >j, separation d at (i,j), and every pair key (distance,(a,b)) >= (d,(i,j)). None admits exactly sequences of length zero or one. Translations, rotations and varying distant points yield ambiguous coordinates and lengths.

metamorphic_relation: Translation and signed coordinate permutations preserving i32 bounds preserve every distance and therefore selected original indices. Input permutations preserve minimum distance but can change index ties.
metamorphic_relation: Positive integral scaling k with representable images multiplies squared distance by k² and preserves indices; k=0 collapses all points and need not preserve indices.

duplicate_fiber: Zero distance iff equal coordinates. Sorted (point,index) runs start with the smallest two indices of each run. Minimum over adjacent equal-point pairs selects the globally least pair. All-equal input returns (0,1,0) without recursion.

decomposition_relation: For x-sorted unique inputs, the global minimum is the minimum of two half minima and cross pairs. Cross pairs no farther than current best have both x distances to split_x <=sqrt(best); inclusive strip and y boundaries retain all distance/index ties.

cost_bound: Duplicates return early, so recursive best distance is positive. At initial delta²=best, each half has internal separation >=delta. A strip of width 2delta and height delta partitions in each half into constant many cells of diameter <delta; hence constant many candidates per point, even with boundary ties. Re-sorting strips gives T(n)=2T(n/2)+O(n log n), O(n log²n); sequential recursion peaks at O(n) vectors.

range_bound: Difference magnitude <=2^32-1; square <2^64; sum <=2(2^32-1)^2<2^65. Widen before subtraction/squaring, then convert nonnegative terms to u128. Original index enumeration preserves identity.
checks: Debug/release twice; strict Clippy; compiled mutant; source-bound syntax twice.
limitations: Finite observations are not universal verification; allocator exhaustion untested; syntax projection lacks semantic type resolution and macro expansion. Exact implementation has no approximate execution profile.
